sentences.text: A Tier 3 UCB may not levy a pre-payment charge on this loan because the applicable rule finding says pre-payment charge is not applicable for this case.

The directions for floating-rate business loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises say a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges only on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh.

For cases other than those covered by that paragraph, pre-payment charges, if any, are to be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and the directions also require disclosure of any applicable pre-payment charge in the sanction letter and loan agreement.
The evidence provided does not show the bank's approved policy or the sanction letter or loan agreement disclosure for this loan.

missing.searched: checked the provided UCB directions and rule findings for the bank's approved policy on pre-payment charges
checked the provided evidence for disclosure of pre-payment charges in the sanction letter and loan agreement
